## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!` / `fix!`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Refactor / performance (`refactor` / `perf`)
- [ ] Build / CI / chore (`build` / `ci` / `chore`)

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] `cargo deny check` passes (if dependencies changed).
- [ ] No new `unsafe` (or an ADR approves an exception).
- [ ] **Docs updated in this PR** (if behavior changed).
- [ ] **Change fragment added** under `changes/unreleased/`.
- [ ] `python scripts/changelog/orbeex.py validate-all` passes.
- [ ] Feature registry updated (if a feature changed state).
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`Signed-off-by`).
